text: Opened PR #6661 for owner-approved issue #6612 at signed/sign-off head 7dc9eb964. It gives VFP-native Autoincrement (+) fields the 11-character numeric SDF layout in both directions, adds exact-byte/alignment coverage, and records distinct dBASE Level 7 semantics. Focused data-I/O and DBF-table tests pass; please review read-only.
